import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_79/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_79/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_79/training_2.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and their types
    target_columns = [
        'fixed acidity', 'volatile acidity', 'citric acid', 'residual sugar', 'chlorides',
        'free sulfur dioxide', 'total sulfur dioxide', 'density', 'pH', 'sulphates',
        'alcohol', 'quality'
    ]

    # Data types for target columns
    dtype_map = {
        'fixed acidity': float,
        'volatile acidity': float,
        'citric acid': float,
        'residual sugar': float,
        'chlorides': float,
        'free sulfur dioxide': int,
        'total sulfur dioxide': int,
        'density': float,
        'pH': float,
        'sulphates': float,
        'alcohol': float,
        'quality': int
    }

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns
        df = df[target_columns]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have exactly the same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) all source dataframes
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Enforce data types as per target schema
    for col, col_type in dtype_map.items():
        if col_type == int:
            # Convert to int safely (rounding floats if any)
            combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].round().astype(int)
        else:
            combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].astype(col_type)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_79/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
